name: Motor Assisted Cycle
description: An e-bike: a cycle with pedals or hand cranks and electric motors totalling no more than 500 W that can't propel it past 32 km/h, in two classes, a pedal-assist-only light e-bike (250 W, 25 km/h) and a standard e-bike that may have a throttle.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels at least 350 mm in diameter, pedals or hand cranks that work while the motor assists, and brakes on every wheel or on each axle
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 182.1(2); Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, s. 4

restrictions.rule: Electric motors with a total continuous power output rating of no more than 500 W that can't propel it past 32 km/h on a clean, paved, level surface; no combustion-engine generator
restrictions.citation: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, s. 3

restrictions.rule: The motor stops when the rider stops pedalling or cranking, releases the throttle, or brakes; one with a throttle needs a separate on/off switch, or must not engage below 3 km/h
restrictions.citation: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, s. 3(2)

restrictions.rule: A light e-bike assists only while pedalling or cranking, has no throttle, and is limited to 250 W and 25 km/h; every other motor assisted cycle is a standard e-bike
restrictions.citation: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, ss. 5 and 6

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 14 or older for a light e-bike and 16 or older for a standard e-bike on a highway
restrictions.citation: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, ss. 8 and 9

restrictions.rule: Riders under 16 may not carry or tow a passenger
restrictions.citation: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, s. 10

restrictions.rule: Rider and any passenger must wear a bicycle safety helmet
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 184(1)

restrictions.rule: A light e-bike must stop within 7.5 m from 25 km/h and a standard e-bike within 9 m from 32 km/h; motor and batteries securely fastened, and every electrical terminal insulated or covered
restrictions.citation: Motor Assisted Cycle (E-Bike) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 64/2024, ss. 12 to 14

restrictions.rule: Has a cyclist's rights and duties: no riding on a sidewalk unless a bylaw or sign allows it, and a white front light, red rear light and red reflector at night
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 183

restrictions.rule: Municipalities may by bylaw bar parents and guardians from letting riders under 16 ride one on paths they designate
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 124(1)(x.1)

restrictions.rule: Not a vehicle under the Motor Vehicle Act or the Off-Road Vehicle Act: no driver's licence, registration or insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 1; Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 1

restrictions.rule: One that doesn't meet every requirement isn't an e-bike: it may be illegal on public roads, or need a licence, registration and insurance
